scope: the four production/counting masking divergences excluded from run cc3a551f-a8a5-4c0d-b90b-d3db2b26858a
rule: the prior state IS on disk; the failing push's own mints are NOT. An absent input is named, never inferred.

failed_arm_record.survives_only: the 60-character prefix pair in the triple reason

cases.failing_boundary: tool_result (the last captured payload is tool_args, which the failing push_call consumes)
absent_state: the two masked outputs of the failing push (production vs counting) beyond their first 60 characters
every substitute the failing push MINTED for values first seen in the tool result: the mint is `secrets`-driven (pseudex/vault.py) and no mapping is persisted, and the capture stops before that push
the vault's `shown_forms` rows written by the failing push's own restore, if any

for the multi-hop cases, a replayable description of the intermediate tool hops: the capture holds their delivered bytes but not the tool call that produced them, so this probe replays only the prefix before the first tool call
required_instrumentation: persist, per push, the two compared strings in full (or their first divergence offset and the 512 bytes around it) instead of raising with a truncated repr
persist the minted (entity_type, real, fake) triples of the failing push, or a seed for the mint, so a replay can be byte-exact
keep the failed arm's transcript/request_count instead of `_empty_run` whenever a capture row was already written
not_claimed: the mechanism is proven for this case
the other three cases have the same trigger
